task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check whether the given month number contains 31 days or not.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method IsMonthWith31Days(month: int) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is true if the input month number corresponds to a month with 31 days
- The result is false if the input month number does not correspond to a month with 31 days
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
    method Has31Days(month: int) returns (result: bool)

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - The input month is an integer representing a month number (1 through 12)  
Dafny specification:  
    requires 1 <= month <= 12

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - The result is true if the month has 31 days  
    - The result is false if the month does not have 31 days

Dafny specification:  
    ensures result <==> (month == 1 || month == 3 || month == 5 || month == 7 || month == 8 || month == 10 || month == 12)

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.  
In this case:

```dafny
method Has31Days(month: int) returns (result: bool)
  requires 1 <= month <= 12
  ensures result <==> (month == 1 || month == 3 || month == 5 || month == 7 || month == 8 || month == 10 || month == 12)
{
    result := (month == 1 || month == 3 || month == 5 || month == 7 || month == 8 || month == 10 || month == 12);
}
```
